import sys, random, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/scratch'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import gen_big, analyze as A
import z3
from math import lcm

seed=int(sys.argv[1]); ns=int(sys.argv[2])
rng = random.Random(seed)
req = gen_big.build(rng, tight=False, nsnap=ns)
inst = A._parse_request(req)
edges=inst['edges']; coms=inst['commodities']; snaps=inst['snapshots']; domains=inst['domains']
S=len(snaps); C=len(coms); E=len(edges)
W=[];coef=[]
for (_cid,_s,_t,routes) in coms:
    row=[0]*E; ws=0
    for p,w in routes:
        ws+=w
        for ei in p: row[ei]+=w
    W.append(ws);coef.append(row)
L=1
for w in W: L=lcm(L,w)
Am=[[coef[c][e]*(L//W[c]) for e in range(E)] for c in range(C)]
for s in range(S):
    q=[z3.Int('q_%d'%c) for c in range(C)]
    n=[z3.Int('n_%d'%e) for e in range(E)]
    base=[]
    bnd=snaps[s][1]
    for c in range(C):
        base.append(q[c]>=bnd[c][0]); base.append(q[c]<=bnd[c][1])
    for e in range(E):
        t=[q[c]*Am[c][e] for c in range(C) if Am[c][e]]
        base.append(n[e]==(z3.Sum(t) if t else z3.IntVal(0)))
        base.append(n[e]<=L*edges[e][3])
    ing={};egr={}
    for i,(_cid,src,tgt,_r) in enumerate(coms):
        ing.setdefault(src,[]).append(i); egr.setdefault(tgt,[]).append(i)
    cidx={c[0]:i for i,c in enumerate(coms)}; eidx={e[0]:i for i,e in enumerate(edges)}
    obs=[]
    for (_oid,metric,target,lo,hi,dom) in snaps[s][4]:
        if metric=='demand': ex=q[cidx[target]]
        elif metric=='link': ex=n[eidx[target]]
        else:
            lst=ing.get(target,()) if metric=='ingress' else egr.get(target,())
            ex=z3.Sum([q[i] for i in lst]) if lst else z3.IntVal(0)
        sc=L if metric=='link' else 1
        obs.append((dom, lo*sc, hi*sc, ex))
    mds = sorted(set(d for (d,_l,_h,_e) in obs if d is not None))
    mv = {d: z3.Bool('m_%s'%d) for d in mds}
    for (d, lo, hi, ex) in obs:
        if d is None:
            base.append(ex>=lo); base.append(ex<=hi)
        else:
            base.append(z3.Implies(mv[d], ex>=lo))
            base.append(z3.Implies(mv[d], ex<=hi))
    sol = z3.Solver(); sol.add(*base)
    t0=time.time()
    # greedy maximal sets
    maximal=[]
    blocked=[]
    while True:
        # find a feasible set, avoiding subsets of already-found maximal sets
        cand = [d for d in mds]  # try starting from all
        # build a starting candidate: all domains
        cur = list(mds)
        ok = True
        # test feasibility of cur
        def feasible(subset):
            s2 = z3.Solver(); s2.add(*base)
            for d in mds:
                if d in subset: s2.add(mv[d])
                else: s2.add(z3.Not(mv[d]))
            return s2.check()==z3.sat
        # start from the full set, remove domains until feasible
        sub = list(mds)
        if not feasible(sub):
            # find a feasible subset by solver search
            s2 = z3.Solver(); s2.add(*base)
            for d in mds: s2.add(mv[d])
            # allow dropping: use soft; simpler: iterate greedy removal
            found=None
            for d in mds:
                trial=[x for x in sub if x!=d]
                if feasible(trial):
                    sub=trial; found=True; break
            if not found:
                # remove 2 at a time, etc.  Fall back to solver-driven search
                s3 = z3.Solver(); s3.add(*base)
                # maximize the number of clean domains via blocking
                # simple approach: ask for any model, then extend greedily
                s3.push()
                r = s3.check()
                if r!=z3.sat:
                    print('snapshot %d: even empty clean set infeasible?!' % s); break
                s3.pop()
                # greedy: start from model's true mv's
                cur_set = set()
                # no mv constraints -> model may set them arbitrarily; collect true ones
                mdl = s3.model()
                for d in mds:
                    v = mdl.eval(mv[d], model_completion=True)
                    if z3.is_true(v): cur_set.add(d)
                sub = list(cur_set)
        # extend greedily
        for d in mds:
            if d in sub: continue
            trial = sub+[d]
            if feasible(trial):
                sub = trial
        maximal.append(tuple(sorted(sub)))
        # block: next maximal set must not be a subset of this one
        # (i.e., must contain some domain outside sub)
        blocked.append(sub)
        s2 = z3.Solver(); s2.add(*base)
        outside = [d for d in mds if d not in sub]
        s2.add(z3.Or([mv[d] for d in outside]))
        r = s2.check()
        if r != z3.sat:
            break
        # restart greedy from the model of s2
        mdl = s2.model()
        cur = [d for d in mds if z3.is_true(mdl.eval(mv[d], model_completion=True))]
        # verify and extend
        sub = [d for d in cur if feasible([x for x in cur if x!=d] )] if False else cur
        # we loop again; the outer loop handles it
        # store a hint: set global 'sub'
        globals()['_hint'] = sub
        feasible_hint = sub
        # simple: continue the while loop, but we need sub to be feasible; use hint
        # (we re-enter the loop which starts from full set; to use the hint we set a flag)
        break_out = False
    print('snapshot %d: %d maximal clean sets: %s (%.2fs)' % (s, len(maximal), maximal[:6], time.time()-t0), flush=True)
